product_one_liner.value: Curve Dental provides an AI-powered, cloud-based practice-management platform for dental practices, combining clinical records, scheduling, insurance, billing, payments, imaging, reporting, and patient engagement.
product_one_liner.notes: Description is from the company's homepage.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists, though it offers personalized quotes and does not publish dollar prices.

named_customers.notes: Both practices and their dentist representatives are named in Curve Dental case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn identifies Curve Dental as having 201–500 employees (the company page reports 215).

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Alpharetta, Georgia as the headquarters; the company About page also lists Alpharetta as an office location.

founded_year.notes: Curve Dental states it was founded in 2004.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is primarily dental-industry, product, and practice-management content; the index does not show two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Curve describes a searchable knowledge base with user guides and tutorials, and its public Zendesk support center contains multiple product-help articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current company job board lists openings but no AI, ML, machine-learning, or data-science-titled role. Search results surfaced an AI/ML listing, but the current board did not list it; the listed Software Developer roles are not AI/ML-titled.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Curve's AI product information and data-policy/security material; Curve describes AI features but does not publicly identify the model or model provider used.

compliance_certs.notes: Curve's data policy names SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in describing its data-center controls and says it follows HIPAA privacy requirements. HIPAA is compliance, not itself a certification; the page does not present it as a certification.

last_funding.notes: Battery Ventures' significant equity investment was announced in February 2018; the amount was undisclosed, so 0 is used as a placeholder rather than a reported amount. Battery lists the investment year as 2018.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest outside funding identified is Battery Ventures' February 2018 equity investment, well before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09. Curve's 2026 R&D investment announcement is not an outside funding round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current job-board openings do not include SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account-executive titles. A Customer Account Executive listing found in search was marked removed on 2026-09-18; Product Specialist and Strategic Account Leader are not qualifying titles under the specified rule.

launched_6mo.notes: Curve announced Curve Memberships on 2026-09-03, within the six-month window beginning 2026-05-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Curve announced Rick Hansen's appointment as Chief Customer Officer on 2026-09-29, inside the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These customer-facing practice marketing, communications, engagement, or reputation-management systems are named as Curve integration/partner offerings on the integrations page; this is not evidence of Curve's own internal CRM.
